rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person bent toward the self's desire by innate disposition lacks guidance from his Lord and is the misguided alternative in the comparison.
rows.anchor: مطرقا إلى هوى نفسه بجبلة طبعه بغير هدى من ربه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The upright walker follows Islam's laws and takes the prophets as models.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the inward reading, the angels ascend carrying the deeds of Adam's descendants.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He glosses al-Rūḥ as “the self's oil” (dahn al-nafs).
rows.anchor: بأعمال بني آدم والروح وهو دهن النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their ascent to God is a witnessing marked by sincerity in the deeds.
rows.anchor: تعرج إلى الله تعالى مشاهدة بالإخلاص في أعماله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The distance to the Throne, measured at fifty thousand years, is crossed in the blink of an eye.
rows.anchor: المسافة إلى العرش التي مقدارها خمسون ألف سنة بطرفة عين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that day each person is occupied by his own concern, distracted from everyone except himself.
rows.anchor: يشغله عن الناس كافة، إلا عن نفسه
